simple: Protects computers and servers (Windows, macOS, Linux) with one lightweight agent managed from the cloud. Blocks malware, ransomware, exploits and fileless attacks: machine learning over 20,000+ file characteristics, behavioral protection of processes and protection against application exploitation techniques. Collects detailed telemetry from computers into the Cortex cloud data lake, where thousands of built-in machine-learning detectors spot attacks in real time; related alerts are automatically grouped into a single case with a risk score and the full attack story. Analytics and response actions also cover network, cloud and identity data when it is connected. Responds through 100+ ready-made playbooks and quick actions, and Live Terminal gives a remote console to the affected computer for investigation and containment; Cortex Agentic Assistant AI agents triage alerts, enrich them and contain the threat on their own. Controls USB drives and Bluetooth devices, the host firewall and disk encryption (BitLocker, FileVault). Sold separately: protection for cloud servers and containers, ITDR, email security, vulnerability assessment (Host Insights), forensics, DLP, attack surface management, and MDR and threat hunting by Unit 42.
